subject: Aligning executive handoff and proposed demo plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Barnes <tom.barnes@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-14T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Aligning executive handoff and proposed demo plan

Tom — great to meet today, thanks for carving out time. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposed next step to keep momentum: 

Key notes from call (very high level)
- Primary use case: customer support deflection + policy-safe generative answers for product pages (high QPS, 512–1024 token contexts).
- Current pain: inconsistent latency at peak, high token cost on existing provider, need private telemetry and audit logs for compliance.
- Buying team: you (Head of Digital Ops), Priya Shah (CTO), procurement (timelines ~Q4), platform engineering (SE deep dive).

Proposed next steps
1) Executive alignment: 30-min VP/CTO intro (Priya) — goal is alignment on timeline, SLAs, and security expectations.
2) Technical deep dive: 60-min session with our Solutions Engineering team to validate throughput/latency and pilot success criteria.

Availability: we have the following windows next week (PST) — please pick what works for Priya and you:
- Tue 9/22 11:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed 9/23 10:00–11:00 (can split into 30+60 back-to-back)
- Thu 9/24 15:00–16:30

Attached a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) and a proposed pilot scope for FYI. If it helps, I can coordinate a brief agenda for the VP/CTO intro (5–10 min goals + 20 min open) and then schedule the SE deep dive directly after.

Ask: can you confirm Priya’s preferred slot and whether procurement needs an NDA or SOW before execs speak?

Thanks — looping in Karthik (AE) and Sergio (SE) to help with scheduling and the tech plan.

—
Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0162
Redwood Inference

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), pilot_scope_onepager.pdf (pdf)

From: Tom Barnes <tom.barnes@acme-retail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning executive handoff and proposed demo plan

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Priya (CTO) is available but prefers late-week slots. A few quick datapoints from our side:
- Procurement timeline: aiming to finalize vendor shortlist by 10/15; pilot decision by end of Oct.
- Compliance: we’ll need SOC2 evidence and an outline of data residency options before procurement signs off.

Priya suggested these options (PST):
- Thu 9/24 15:30–16:00 (works if we keep to 30)
- Fri 9/25 09:00–09:30 (earlier preferred)

We’d like the technical deep dive to include load envelope expectations, quantization/latency tradeoffs, and evidence of audit logs/retention controls. I’ll loop Priya on the email here — her address is priya.shah@acme-retail.com.

Also attaching the vendor questionnaire template procurement will use — procurement usually asks for SOC2 + encryption docs up front.

Tom
Head of Digital Ops | Acme Retail
Tom.Barnes@acme-retail.com

Attachments: acme_vendor_questionnaire.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme-retail.com>, Tom Barnes <tom.barnes@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-15T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning executive handoff and proposed demo plan

Priya — thanks for jumping in. Great to meet you virtually — I’ll keep this short:

Proposed flow for the exec intro (30 min)
- 0–5 min: quick intros + desired outcomes (you and Tom)
- 5–15 min: high-level architecture & how Redwood addresses latency/cost (Marissa + Karthik)
- 15–25 min: security/compliance hooks + deployment options (Sergio)
- 25–30 min: confirm next steps (pilot checklist + procurement asks)

Sergio will prepare a short slide with audit/tokens/retention controls and a one-slide latency/throughput summary. Karthik — can you confirm that we can bring a short 60-min SE slot immediately after the exec intro to walk infra/benchmarks? We can do back-to-back to minimize executive time.

We can also provide:
- SOC 2 summary + auditor contact (pdf)
- short telemetry screenshots showing per-token latency at 90th/95th percentiles
- a simple SOW template for pilot (1–3 months)

If Thu 9/24 15:30–16:00 PST works, I’ll send a calendar invite for a 30-min VP/CTO intro and tentatively reserve 16:00–17:00 for the SE deep dive. Otherwise Fri 9/25 09:00–09:30 is also open.

Calendly for exec intro: https://calendly.com/redwood/executive-intro-30m
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/RDW-2026-4721

—
Marissa

Attachments referenced: SOC2_summary_redwood.pdf, latency_report_90_95.png

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme-retail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tom Barnes <tom.barnes@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning executive handoff and proposed demo plan

Marissa — Thu 9/24 15:30–16:00 PST works for the exec intro. Appreciate the concise agenda. A couple quick asks so we can prep:

1) Can you drop the SOC2 summary and a short bullet list of data residency options in the calendar invite? Procurement will need that for the vendor pack.
2) For the SE deep dive, we’d like a one-slide load test result (qps at 95th latency) and clarification on whether KV caching persists across restarts for our pilot.

We’ll take the 16:00–17:00 tentative slot for the SE deep dive. Tom will set up the calendar on our side once you send the invite.

See you Thursday — Priya
CTO | Acme Retail
priya.shah@acme-retail.com
